raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Upper-Body Program (Shoulder-Friendly)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Upper-body strength and endurance without overhead loading"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation (Weeks 1-4)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          chest_fly 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Upper Body B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          skull_crusher 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          chest_fly 2x12..15 rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x10..12 rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x10..12 rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Upper Body B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 2x12..15 rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x10..12 rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
          skull_crusher 2x10..12 rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          chest_fly 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Upper Body B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          skull_crusher 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper Deload A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 40m "Upper Deload B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
  PHASE "Phase 2: Build (Weeks 5-8)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Strength A":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5..6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          chest_fly 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 50m "Upper Hypertrophy B":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          chest_fly 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          skull_crusher 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Strength A":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x4..5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          chest_fly 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 50m "Upper Hypertrophy B":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 4x10..12 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 4x12..15 rpe 7..8 rest 60 seconds
          chest_fly 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          skull_crusher 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Strength A":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3..4 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          bent_over_row 5x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          chest_fly 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 50m "Upper Hypertrophy B":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 5x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          cable_row 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          chest_fly 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          skull_crusher 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper Deload A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 40m "Upper Deload B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
  PHASE "Phase 3: Peak and Capacity (Weeks 9-12)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper Power-Strength A":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 6x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          chest_fly 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 55m "Upper Capacity B":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 5x4..5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          seated_row 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          chest_fly 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          skull_crusher 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper Power-Strength A":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x2..3 rpe 8..9 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 5x4..5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          chest_fly 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 55m "Upper Capacity B":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 5x3..4 rpe 8..9 rest 150 seconds
          seated_row 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          chest_fly 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          skull_crusher 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Consolidation A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x4 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Upper Consolidation B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x4 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          seated_row 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          chest_fly 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper Deload/Taper A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 40m "Upper Deload/Taper B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
